title: Review Disposition Receipt (v1)
description: THREAD-reply marker recording WHY a review thread was resolved. Embedded in a pull-request review-comment reply as `<!-- disposition:v1 {json} -->` and posted by scripts/reviews/disposition (the ONLY sanctioned resolve path — it posts this reply, then calls resolveReviewThread as an internal subprocess). The check-pr-review-convergence closeout reads these to compute dispositions_missing_marker, followups_without_issue, unreachable_fix_commits, and the writer set (#3693 R1). Class-specific evidence is required: fixed→commit, refuted→argument, superseded→superseded_by, follow-up→issue.

thread_id.description: The review thread this disposition resolves.

by.description: Identity of the disposer (a member of the writer set).

head.description: The PR headRefOid this disposition was posted at.

evidence.description: Class-specific evidence. Exactly the field for the class is required.

commit.description: fixed: the SHA that fixed it (must be reachable from head).

argument.description: refuted: why the finding does not hold.

superseded_by.description: superseded: the PR/issue/commit that supersedes it.
